# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: PER Abu Musa 1970 — scripted effects.
# COLDWAR | Abu Musa 1970. Generated by tools/gulf_1970/abu_musa.py.
COLDWAR_PER_observe_abu_musa_withdrawal = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_campaign = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_withdrawal_window
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_final_withdrawal_day
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = UAE
				UAE = { is_subject_of = ENG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_observed_nonce = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce }
			if = {
				limit = { UAE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_historical_withdrawal_schedule } }
				if = { limit = { date > 1971.9.1 date < 1971.12.1 } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_withdrawal_window }
				if = { limit = { date > 1971.11.29 date < 1971.12.1 } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_final_withdrawal_day }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { UAE = { has_variable = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_due } }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_remaining = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_contract_due }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_remaining = global.date }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_remaining > 0 } check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_remaining value = 2.16 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_withdrawal_window
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_remaining value = 0.024 compare = less_than_or_equals } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_final_withdrawal_day }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_PER_prepare_abu_musa = {
	COLDWAR_PER_observe_abu_musa_withdrawal = yes
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_PER_can_prepare_abu_musa = yes NOT = { has_political_power < 50 } }
		add_political_power = -50
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_operation_prepared
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_landing_preparations days = 90 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_PER_assert_abu_musa = {
	COLDWAR_PER_observe_abu_musa_withdrawal = yes
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_PER_can_assert_abu_musa = yes NOT = { has_political_power < 25 } }
		add_political_power = -25
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_claim_asserted
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_landing_preparations
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_landing_preparations days = 90 }
		create_wargoal = { type = take_state_focus target = UAE generator = { 1119 } }
		UAE = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PER modifier = COLDWAR_PER_abu_musa_coercion } }
	}
}
